species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 49°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 66–144 ft deep, mostly on drop-offs.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.

species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 49°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.
